scope: Schema 6. Recalculated from the current isolated suite and named browser or simulation evidence; hardware, human and release gates stay separate.

requirements.requirement: Rental, paid bus stops, parking capacity, traffic signals and junction reservations
requirements.implemented_and_gap: Funded transit, rental escrow, finite parking, directed-lane turns, deterministic signals, occupancy reservations and cross-lane/yield safety are implemented. Five focused traffic tests plus integrated mobility and real browser travel/rental controls verify these boundaries.
requirements.next_action: Retain evidence and rerun when its inputs change.

requirements.requirement: Clear/cloud/rain/wind weather and 0.5x/1x/2x time controls; cosmetic aging
requirements.implemented_and_gap: Four seeded weather states and0.5/1/2wall-clock cadence retain fixed authority. Player age is cosmetic and visible in the life panel; NPC demography follows the higher-priority society contract.
requirements.next_action: Retain evidence and rerun when its inputs change.

requirements.requirement: Player heavy attack and dodge controls
requirements.implemented_and_gap: Real G heavy-attack and Space dodge inputs use the same authoritative combat/stamina/cooldown rules.
requirements.next_action: Retain evidence and rerun when its inputs change.

requirements.requirement: Daily XP ceiling, perk/unlock progression
requirements.implemented_and_gap: One20point daily allowance covers all skill sources; professional perk requires five completed shifts and pays a backed wage bonus.
requirements.next_action: Retain evidence and rerun when its inputs change.

requirements.requirement: University lesson, club and school social hierarchy
requirements.implemented_and_gap: Three attended courses and certificate-gated jobs coexist with a paid study club, actual attendance and earned hierarchy.
requirements.next_action: Retain evidence and rerun when its inputs change.

requirements.requirement: Faction membership/hierarchy, one leader, treasury, rivals, heat, personal loyalty and contested territory
requirements.implemented_and_gap: Three factions have unique leader/member roles, actual treasury accounts, rivals, heat, personal loyalty and bounded contested influence; dues and services transfer real funds.
requirements.next_action: Retain evidence and rerun when its inputs change.

requirements.requirement: False witness reports, limited police knowledge/capacity, separate arrest/custody/acquittal outcomes
requirements.implemented_and_gap: Twelve justice tests cover evidence-limited knowledge, two concurrent admissions and distinct legal outcomes. Weekly economy cannot settle or forgive pending NPC cases; queue wait cannot count as admitted investigation time. Both regressions failed before the fix and pass on current sources.
requirements.next_action: Retain evidence and rerun when its inputs change.

requirements.requirement: Stolen item provenance and victim inventory bound
requirements.implemented_and_gap: One existing stock unit is transferred without payment and linked to a real victim, item and incident. Only that unit can be returned once; a return does not erase evidence.
requirements.source_evidence: simulation/property-crime.ts; UI shop and inventory; persistence fixtures
requirements.next_action: Retain evidence and rerun when its inputs change.

requirements.requirement: Guardians, dependents, bounded births/deaths/migration, tombstones and debt-first estates/inheritance
requirements.implemented_and_gap: Bounded births/deaths, adult guardians, capacity-safe housing/moves, nonrecycled identities and debt-first estates preserve custody, deeds and money.
requirements.next_action: Retain evidence and rerun when its inputs change.

requirements.requirement: Rumor source/confidence, repeatable salience decay, critical memories and familiarity/loyalty
requirements.implemented_and_gap: Rumor source chains and confidence, salience decay, protected critical memories, familiarity and loyalty preserve observer knowledge boundaries.
requirements.next_action: Retain evidence and rerun when its inputs change.

requirements.classification: Concrete routine behavior; algorithm is proposal
requirements.requirement: Background scheduled travel arrivals, shop hours/queues, school routines and missed-work consequence
requirements.implemented_and_gap: Abstract trips retain the departure location until actual arrival. Attendance governs wages, children commute to school, and shared bounded FIFO queues plus real business hours constrain purchases.
requirements.next_action: Retain evidence and rerun when its inputs change.

requirements.requirement: Taxes, resource-constrained production, market demand/stock prices and district indicators
requirements.implemented_and_gap: Finite wholesale inputs and labor constrain funded production. Recorded demand and stock change prices; tax transfers and derived district indicators reconcile exact balances.
requirements.next_action: Retain evidence and rerun when its inputs change.

requirements.requirement: Bounded strikes, migration/public works and measurable district shock duration/severity
requirements.implemented_and_gap: State-driven strikes and funded public works have bounded duration/output effects; housing moves and distress affect employment and district indicators.
requirements.next_action: Retain evidence and rerun when its inputs change.

requirements.requirement: Exclusive participants AND locations, causal unresolved facts, choices/effects/fallback definitions
requirements.implemented_and_gap: All20 causal branches are reached on current source using ordinary validated commands and simulated schedules; participant/location locks, choices, effects and fallback are validated separately. The reachability harness explicitly offers eligible events, so this is not a claim that the random scheduler selects every branch within seven days.
requirements.next_action: Retain evidence and rerun when its inputs change.

requirements.requirement: Inventory slot limit and unique item identity
requirements.implemented_and_gap: Weight30 and12distinct stack slots constrain purchase/delivery atomically; owned item instances retain stable identity and consumption removes corresponding units.
requirements.next_action: Retain evidence and rerun when its inputs change.

requirements.requirement: Voluntary retirement endpoint without mandatory game over
requirements.implemented_and_gap: Voluntary retirement freezes world time, preserves obligations and supports explicit return; no forced player game-over.
requirements.next_action: Retain evidence and rerun when its inputs change.

requirements.requirement: Replayable durable command-journal tail and corrupt-tail quarantine
requirements.implemented_and_gap: Four current browser journal cases pass, including the original100000tick burst, exact-tail reload, concurrent-tab conflict and WebGL-loss recovery. QA stepping yields between fixed500tick chunks without changing authoritative order; production QA remains disabled.
requirements.next_action: Retain evidence and rerun when its inputs change.

requirements.requirement: Per-object schemaVersion/updatedTick, separate rules version, immutable profile store, bounded delta projection
requirements.implemented_and_gap: Normalized records have identity/schema/reconciliation tick; immutable profiles have one persisted owner and separate rules version. Worker projections are bounded full views; ADR9 documents representation semantics and avoids claiming true field-delta encoding.
requirements.next_action: Retain evidence and rerun when its inputs change.

requirements.requirement: Priority heap, spatial hash, hierarchical routing, route invalidation, offscreen scheduling
requirements.implemented_and_gap: ADR10 documents cached static A*, deterministic sorted arrival commitments and bounded local scans in place of proposed heap/spatial-hash hierarchy. This credits the justified algorithm choice only; it does not approve unmet performance budgets.
requirements.next_action: Retain evidence and rerun when its inputs change.

requirements.requirement: Reduced-fidelity main-thread worker fallback; optional-asset placeholder/retry
requirements.implemented_and_gap: Reduced-visual-fidelity main-thread fallback preserves the same domain state. Optional props have bounded placeholder/retry behavior. Five real headless WebGL create/render/destroy cycles now return all owned atlas cache entries and aliases to baseline; the pre-fix2-per-restart leak is preserved as failed evidence. Current built asset-fault and fallback browser reruns also pass after this renderer-only fix.
requirements.next_action: Retain evidence and rerun when its inputs change.

requirements.requirement: 10,000-NPC synthetic benchmark; 100,000 random validated commands
requirements.implemented_and_gap: Current-source100000validated-command fuzz passes. A genuine10000citizen/28800tick synthetic world completes with no invariants lost. CPU p95=0.1425ms, p99=3.988ms, max=982.45ms under concurrent load; this is capacity correctness, not a production hardware/performance pass.
requirements.next_action: Retain evidence and rerun when its inputs change.

requirements.requirement: Two human30-minute playtests; browser native200%zoom; real hidden tab; reference PC/low-end long soak
requirements.implemented_and_gap: Earlier native zoom evidence is historical. Two human sessions are deferred, and reference hardware, low-end hardware and repeatable visibility on a dedicated host remain unverified. An unattended two-hour wall clock does not by itself satisfy the continuity requirement.
requirements.next_action: Keep open; no waiver or inferred pass.

requirements.requirement: Combined debt + job loss + wanted + health recovery; all20event branches reload; three livelihoods7days
requirements.implemented_and_gap: Combined debt/job-loss/wanted/health recovery uses real commands and paid assistance/work/repayment; all20 branches reload; three distinct legal livelihoods run seven days. Fixtures and accelerated ticks are disclosed, not human-play evidence.
requirements.next_action: Retain evidence and rerun when its inputs change.

requirements.requirement: Immutable preview/providerSHA/CI/rollback, production verification
requirements.implemented_and_gap: User restricted work to local commits and suspended merge/production. Actual local built route is verified by served manifest. Remote PR/CI/provider identity, final external preview and production/rollback evidence remain absent.
requirements.next_action: Keep open; no waiver or inferred pass.

resolved_or_nonmandatory: Audio disabled by explicit project instruction and ADR6; not a forgotten requested audio feature.
1,100 initial population retained; 5k–10k production capacity is a future target, distinct from specified10k synthetic test.
Detailed courtroom procedure, multiple districts, multiplayer and photorealistic3D are expressly outside1.0.
100ms fixed physics/simulation authority,24-minute game day and relation scale decisions are documented ADR2–4, not silently marked implementation failures.
Illustrative interface/folder names and proposed utility weights are not independently product acceptance requirements.
